content: {"question":"What is the maximum time allowed to file an expense report before it is not reimbursed, and what is the default payment method for airfare bookings?","answer":"Expense reports must be filed within 90 days of purchase, and airfare is charged immediately to GitLab’s central company card.","evidence_a":"File your expense report in a timely manner, as expense claims over 90 days from purchase date will not be reimbursed unless approved by your Manager.","evidence_b":"Airfare: All airfare is charged immediately at the time of booking to the card on file. GitLab's central card is the default payment method in the system and will always be available."}
